headline: Weathered Expanse Leads Renewed Front Activity
war_summary: Since the last edition, Weathered Expanse has strengthened its claim to the war desk: 55 base events now mark the past 24 hours, including nine in the latest two-hour watch, though both casualty rates are cooling. Its ledger lists one Warden, five Colonial, and three neutral bases. Marban Hollow has eased from 35 to 30 daily events and is quiet in the newest watch, while retaining four Warden, three Colonial, and one neutral holdings. Nevish Line likewise has slowed to 31 events, with none in the latest two hours, and stands at five Warden and three Colonial bases. Linn Mercy remains a violent but cooling front, rising to 25 events and recording one in the latest watch; ten Colonial bases and one neutral are listed. Mooring County has quickened markedly from 15 to 23 events, three of them recent, around an eleven-Warden, one-neutral position. Kuura Strand, once a notable flashpoint, has seven daily events but none in the latest watch. Callahan’s Passage shows heavy casualty activity without recorded base events, a reminder that the guns have not fallen silent everywhere.
